newsitem.title: MEXICO: Police, peasants clash in Mexico, three dead.
newsitem.headline: Police, peasants clash in Mexico, three dead.
newsitem.dateline: SAN CRISTOBAL DE LAS CASAS, Mexico 1997-03-15

text.p: At least three people died in a clash between police and peasants in the southern state of Chiapas on Friday, newspapers reported on Saturday.
Another six people were wounded and 27 people were being held by police in the community of San Pedro Nixtalocum, the state government said in a statement.
The clashes took place between police and local members of the opposition Party of the Democratic Revolution, who support the Zapatista Army for National Liberation, reports said.
Police were called in after three members of the ruling Revolutionary Institutional Party disappeared.
Other clashes earlier in the week left others dead.
The violence marks a return to the tension that has afflicted the state since the Zapatista rebels rose up in arms in January 1, 1994. Since then, peace talks have sputtered.
